findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body: Returning `true` unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant. This replaces the explicit tenant equality check and creates a direct cross-tenant authorization bypass wherever this exported predicate controls access.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally; the full base-to-head diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so cross-tenant reads remain permitted. The later incremental commit only changes src/labels.ts and does not address access control.
